corporation_name.rationale: No canonical element for corporation name exists in this schedule's candidate list; it belongs to the parent 1120-S form header.

ein.rationale: No canonical element for EIN exists in this schedule's candidate list; it belongs to the parent 1120-S form header.

tax_year_begin.rationale: No canonical element for tax year begin date exists in this schedule's candidate list; it belongs to the parent 1120-S form header.

tax_year_end.rationale: No canonical element for tax year end date exists in this schedule's candidate list; it belongs to the parent 1120-S form header.

m1_net_income_loss_per_books.rationale: NetIncomeLossPerBooksAmt directly corresponds to Schedule M-1 line 1, net income (loss) per books.

m1_income_on_return_not_on_books.rationale: TotalIncmNotRecordedOnBooksAmt corresponds to Schedule M-1 line 2, income included on Schedule K not recorded on books.

m1_expenses_on_books_not_on_return.rationale: TotalExpensesNotDeductedAmt corresponds to Schedule M-1 line 3, expenses recorded on books not included on Schedule K.

m1_income_on_books_not_on_return.rationale: TotIncmRecordedNotIncludedAmt corresponds to Schedule M-1 line 5, income recorded on books not included on Schedule K.

m1_deductions_on_return_not_on_books.rationale: TotalDeductionsNotChargedAmt corresponds to Schedule M-1 line 6, deductions included on Schedule K not charged against book income.

m1_income_loss_per_schedule_k.rationale: IncomeLossAmt corresponds to Schedule M-1 line 7, income (loss) per Schedule K.
